name: upload_file
description: Upload a file through a provided element.

filePaths.description: One or more files paths to upload. File paths have to be local to the browser instance (not the MCP).

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of the file input element or an element that will open file chooser on the page from the page content snapshot
